title: Nadodikkattu
desc: After losing their jobs, Dasan and Vijayan decide to go to Dubai to try their luck. But they end up in a different location, where they are mistaken for crime investigation officers.

title: Bharathchandran I.P.S.
desc: Hyder Ali Hassan, a scheming politician, is in league with the underworld and runs a lot of illegal businesses. Balachandran, an IPS officer, is sent on a mission to capture him.

title: Chess
desc: A man murders his rich brother-in-law with the help of three co-conspirators to amass his wealth. He also manages to discredit the deceased man's illegitimate son.

title: Big Snake King
desc: After they slight a giant snake and disturb its slumber, the people of a village engage in a desperate ploy of human sacrifice to stay safe.

title: King Of Serpant
desc: A man's small village faces certain death unless he kills a giant python. So, he leads the hunt against the beast to keep his village safe.

title: Pon Manickavel
desc: Pon Manickavel, IPS officer, is given the task to solve the case of a judge's murder. While his team attempts to crack the crime, the lives of high-profile persons are threatened.
